correctness.rationale: The proof normalizes one codeword to 0000 under an exact symmetry, exhaustively rejects every normalized 13-word code, directly exhibits 12-word codes, enumerates all 832 normalized maxima and all 5,616 labeled maxima, and reconstructs the two full natural-group orbits. The embedded verifier recomputes every predicate from the definition and its final replay matches all stated counts.

value.rationale: This closes the smallest ternary instance singled out by the classical four-row separating-hash question, raising the historical construction from 10 to the exact optimum 12. The complete equality census and two natural-equivalence types add structural information useful for benchmarking constructions and small-parameter bounds; the parameter is motivated by a named open finite case rather than an arbitrary slice.
